description: Codex: Orks (11e) Runt Swarm — SNEAKY LITTLE GITZ (WP-O34): Gretchin have BATTLELINE; a GRETCHIN unit's advance/fall-back move does not prevent it from starting an action. Setup: detachment Runt Swarm (BATTLELINE granted); Custodian Guard Charlie moved within 9" of Gretchin Delta so they have a target and can be selected to shoot. Movement phase: Gretchin Delta clicked, Advance + Confirm, End This Unit's Move: advanced, no action lock. Shooting phase: Gretchin Delta offered the Hold Position action and START_ACTION succeeds (the phase's own action: the Start Action button exists only for a unit that can be selected to shoot, which advanced Gretchin without [ASSAULT] weapons cannot — a pre-existing UI limitation, reported).

steps.script:
GameState.state["factions"]["1"]["detachment"] = "Runt Swarm"
StratagemManager.load_faction_stratagems_for_player(1)
FactionAbilityManager.detect_player_detachment(1)
load("res://scripts/codex/orks/OrkDetachments11e.gd").apply_keyword_grants(1)
SettingsService.set("auto_allocate_wounds", true)
var _ms_U_CUSTODIAN_GUARD_C = GameState.state.units["U_CUSTODIAN_GUARD_C"].models
for _i in range(_ms_U_CUSTODIAN_GUARD_C.size()):
	_ms_U_CUSTODIAN_GUARD_C[_i]["position"] = {"x": (7.000000 + (float(_i) - float(_ms_U_CUSTODIAN_GUARD_C.size() - 1) / 2.0) * 1.800000) * 40.0, "y": 20.500000 * 40.0}
for _m in GameState.state.units["U_CUSTODIAN_GUARD_C"].models:
	_m["wounds"] = 99
	_m["current_wounds"] = 99
GameState.state.players["2"]["cp"] = 0
tree.current_scene._recreate_unit_visuals()
return FactionAbilityManager.get_player_detachment(1)
steps.comment: setup privilege: the fixture's Ork detachment is switched to Runt Swarm (stratagems + detachment rules reloaded)
still eligible to start an action after advancing
the advanced Gretchin are offered the Hold Position action
starting the action gave up shooting (16.01)
